restaurants.name: <UNKNOWN>
restaurants.notes: Probably the best Indian food they've had in London. Described as fantastic food, fantastic restaurant with Lucknow-based cuisine. Notable dishes include exceptional papadums, a two-Michelin star soup, lamb brains, and other delicacies.

title: Chefs Try London's Best Pizza

restaurants.name: Mall Bro
restaurants.notes: A new pub serving crispy pizza. The chefs were very impressed, with one stating it was the best pizza they've ever tasted. They praised how light and perfectly cooked the pizza was despite the thick crust.

title: Chefs Review London's Best Kebabs

restaurants.name: Best Kebab
restaurants.notes: They visited this place and tried doner kebab made from 100% lamb shoulder. The founder opened it in 1982. Jack described it as 'the best kebab of my life' - very delicious, clean, not greasy, with uniform minced meat (kufta style rather than sliced yaprak).

restaurants.name: Sinto
restaurants.notes: They stopped here for Negronis before heading to their final kebab stop. Described as having a good cocktail list.

restaurants.name: Superb
restaurants.notes: Their final kebab stop visited around 1 am where they tried chicken doner, veal doner, and lamb doner. The chicken doner was described as comforting and well-made with high-quality ingredients, though not as luxurious as the lamb and veal options.

title: Chefs Compete for Best Oyster

restaurants.name: Bentley's Oyster Festival
restaurants.notes: More Fallow competed in the oyster festival competition, defending their 2026 champion title with creative oyster dishes featuring ponzu sauce, truffle, and other ingredients.

title: Chefs Review One of London's Oldest Restaurants ft. Lagom Chef

restaurants.name: Pavyllon
restaurants.notes: One Michelin star restaurant by Yannick Alléno. They praised it as serving the best breakfast in London, with exceptional eggs Benedict, croissants, full English breakfast, and French toast. Called it 'flawless' with no complaints.

restaurants.name: Simpson's
restaurants.notes: Historic British restaurant opened in 1828, reopened by Jeremy King. They highly praised the food, particularly the roast beef which they called 'the best' and 'incredible', and noted the inspiring dining room atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Nellie's Tavern
restaurants.notes: Invitation-only basement bar at Simpson's where they had Negroni cocktails. Named after Mrs. Pavlova, it's a night bar where they spent time before heading home.

title: Chef Eats His Dream Meal
Chefs Review Michelin BBQ

restaurants.name: The Ned
restaurants.notes: Will and Jack dined here for a Michelin BBQ collaboration from Texas featuring Interstellar BBQ x La Barbecue.

title: Chefs Review the Best Ever Seafood Meal

restaurants.name: Dorian
restaurants.notes: Josh Niland's pop-up at Dorian. Described as a contemporary master of seafood who has 'changed the fish game' for good. Will and Jack dined here and reviewed it as the best ever seafood meal.

restaurants.name: Kawan
restaurants.notes: Uncle Roger's new fried rice restaurant in central London. The chefs praised the rustic fried rice as "probably one of the best in London," the curries as "very, very tasty" and warming, and overall found the food "delicious" with good value pricing and a cool atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Oudh 1722
restaurants.notes: Aktar Islam's new restaurant serving progressive Awadhi cuisine from Lucknow. The chefs praised it as "one of the best in London this year, if not all" and "possibly the best Indian meal of my life," highlighting the incredible food quality, Michelin-star level service, and thoughtful, nuanced dishes with sophisticated balance of flavors.

restaurants.name: Prime Mutton
restaurants.notes: A bar/pub known for serving what Aidan calls "the best Guinness in London." The reviewer gave the creamy Guinness pint a solid 7.5 out of 10, praising it as "really nice and creamy" though not a legendary masterpiece.

restaurants.name: Maison Francois

restaurants.name: Golden Dragon

title: What Chef Techniques Are Actually Worth It?

restaurants.name: Otto's
restaurants.notes: Mentioned as doing a lot of table side flambéing. The hosts consider doing flambé there but note there's not enough space.

restaurants.name: The Ritz
restaurants.notes: They visited for fine dining and had a pigeon dish cooked in a press with flambéed brandy/cognac and pan jus. Described as incredibly romantic.

restaurants.name: Black Bear Burger
restaurants.notes: Jack's favorite burger restaurant. Has six chains and offers delivery. They reference it as a burger style they enjoy.

restaurants.name: Five Guys
restaurants.notes: Both hosts like Five Guys. They mention the possibility of doing a live stream visit there to order burgers.

restaurants.name: Shortleaf
restaurants.notes: South African restaurant in central London with about 80 seats. Chef Mayo does guest residencies at Fallow. Menu highlights include lamb head. First two seatings both sold out within weeks.

Chefs Review the Best Steakhouse in the UK

restaurants.name: Blacklock
restaurants.notes: They praised it as probably the best steakhouse in the UK with excellent quality beef, lamb, and pork cooked using traditional methods. The chefs appreciated the meat sourcing, simplicity of menu, generous portions, and outstanding sides. They felt it was a fantastic experience with great service and reasonable pricing for the quality.

restaurants.name: Soma
restaurants.notes: They visited this cocktail bar in Canary Wharf (which also has a location in Soho) briefly. The description was brief, but they had a positive photo moment there with good views.

Chefs Review the Best Pizza in the UK

restaurants.name: Crisp at The Marlborough
restaurants.notes: Chefs visited this new pub in Mayfair serving Crisp pizza made by David Portna. They praised the pizza as the best in the UK and possibly the world, noting the exceptional crispiness of the base, perfectly balanced flavors, and incredible technique. They ordered multiple styles including traditional and grandma's pizzas, all of which they rated extremely highly.

title: Chefs Kebab Crawl Through London

restaurants.name: Londonets
restaurants.notes: Gas and wood fire kebab shop serving Londoner kebab. Praised for quality slicing technique and the most popular item. Reviewers impressed with the lamb and veal fat and overall execution.

restaurants.name: Best Kebab
restaurants.notes: Now using automatic slicers. 100% lamb shoulder meat made in-house. Doner praised for not being oily despite being juicy, with simple quality ingredients: meat, onion, chili sauce, and lemon.
